protocol: MCP Streamable HTTP, stateless (2026-07-28) with a 2025-11-25 legacy lane

tools.name: get_dataset_info
tools.purpose: Read manifest, source hashes, citation and export URLs

tools.name: search_accessibility
tools.purpose: Search published task and criterion references with bounds

tools.name: get_criterion
tools.purpose: Retrieve source reference and related task records

tools.name: get_arrm_task
tools.purpose: Retrieve original ARRM task and recorded ownership

tools.name: get_role_guidance
tools.purpose: Retrieve reviewed project interpretations if available; otherwise explicit missing-review status and original task records. Never fabricate.

tools.name: compare_roles
tools.purpose: Compare recorded role assignments for a criterion or task

constraints: W3C source material and project interpretation are distinct
Every response contains source provenance and revision
No fabricated role guidance is published
Deployment is opt-in and not wired to the Pages workflow
